chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn al-Muthanna, who said:

I forgot the two cycles of the prayer of Tawaf behind the Standing Place of Ibrahim (peace be upon him) until I reached Mina, so I returned to Mecca and prayed them. We mentioned that to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), and he said: 'Why did you not pray them where you remembered?'

key_terms.خَلْفَ مَقَامِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ: Behind the Station of Ibrahim, the specific location where the two cycles of Tawaf prayer are recommended to be performed.
key_terms.رَكْعَتَيِ الطَّوَافِ: The two cycles of prayer performed immediately after completing the circumambulation (Tawaf) of the Kaaba.
key_terms.مَكَّةَ: Mecca, the holy city containing the Kaaba.
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, a valley near Mecca where pilgrims stay during Hajj.

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for making up the two cycles of prayer missed during Tawaf if one forgets them until reaching Mina?
ai.summary: This narration from al-Kafi highlights the principle of 'ease in hardship' (taysir) within Shia jurisprudence, where the Imam (peace be upon him) prioritizes the fulfillment of the obligation over the strict preservation of the original location. It establishes that the missed two cycles of Salat al-Tawaf are treated as a debt to be settled immediately upon remembrance, regardless of distance, reflecting the practical flexibility granted to pilgrims during the Hajj rituals.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hisham Bin Al Musna who said,

‘I forgot my two Cycles (of the Salaat of the) Tawaaf behind the Standing Place of Ibrahimas, until I ended up to Mina. So I returned to Makkah and Prayed these two. So, we mentioned that to Abu Abdullahasws, and heasws said: ‘But, he could have Prayed these two where he remembered’.
en.sarwar: 4. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from Flisham ibn al-Muthanna’ who has said the following: “I once forgot the two Rak‘at Salat (prayer) after Tawaf near Maqam (station) of Ibrahim ‘Alayhi al- Salam, until I reached Mina’, then I returned to Makkah and performed the two Rak‘at. We then mentioned it to abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, and he (the Imam) said, ‘He could have performed them where he remembered.’”
